detail.longDescription: At Zapier, we're big believers in automation. That's a given. But our platform goes beyond automating simple "if this, then that" work—you can build fully automated systems for your work. You can set these systems up from the AI tool you already use, or build them directly in Zapier, whichever you prefer.
